declarations.index event_check_executions_recent: CREATE INDEX EVENT_CHECK_EXECUTIONS_RECENT ON PROJECTION_EVENT_CHECK_EXECUTIONS ( CHECK_ID , STARTED_AT DESC , EXECUTION_ID )
declarations.index event_check_outbox_pending: CREATE INDEX EVENT_CHECK_OUTBOX_PENDING ON PROJECTION_EVENT_CHECK_OUTBOX ( DELIVERY_ID , CREATED_AT , EVENT_ID )
declarations.index event_checks_agent: CREATE INDEX EVENT_CHECKS_AGENT ON PROJECTION_EVENT_CHECKS ( AGENT_ID , CHECK_ID )
declarations.index event_checks_due: CREATE INDEX EVENT_CHECKS_DUE ON PROJECTION_EVENT_CHECKS ( ACTIVE , NEXT_CHECK_AT )
declarations.table projection_event_check_executions: CREATE TABLE PROJECTION_EVENT_CHECK_EXECUTIONS ( EXECUTION_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY , CHECK_ID TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES PROJECTION_EVENT_CHECKS ( CHECK_ID ) ON DELETE CASCADE , STARTED_AT TEXT NOT NULL , RESULT_JSON TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( JSON_VALID ( RESULT_JSON ) ) )
declarations.table projection_event_check_outbox: CREATE TABLE PROJECTION_EVENT_CHECK_OUTBOX ( EVENT_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY , CHECK_ID TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES PROJECTION_EVENT_CHECKS ( CHECK_ID ) ON DELETE CASCADE , REVISION TEXT NOT NULL , PAYLOAD_JSON TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( JSON_VALID ( PAYLOAD_JSON ) ) , CREATED_AT TEXT NOT NULL , DELIVERY_ID TEXT )
declarations.table projection_event_checks: CREATE TABLE PROJECTION_EVENT_CHECKS ( CHECK_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY , AGENT_ID TEXT NOT NULL , DEFINITION_JSON TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ( JSON_VALID ( DEFINITION_JSON ) ) , ACTIVE INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ( ACTIVE IN ( 0 , 1 ) ) , NEXT_CHECK_AT TEXT NOT NULL , BASELINE_JSON TEXT CHECK ( BASELINE_JSON IS NULL OR JSON_VALID ( BASELINE_JSON ) ) , LAST_SUCCESS_AT TEXT , REVISION TEXT NOT NULL )
